meanings: Yory (a cradle-name; names are names): Jory of Eldhythe, who whistled on the east wall; the Book's English writes the glide y- as J-
derivation: a cradle-name: names are names (no sense given). Its first sound is the glide y- /j/, which living Orrowen has only as a worn (softened) g (orrowen_v2 §2.1, §2.4): the name is said and written with that onset frozen, as the suppletive yal- is (O2831, 're + S gal'), the worn form a name takes when it is called (the vocative, §3.3) and when it is a possessor. The tongue has no j (§2.5), so the Book's Jory is Seren's Yory, its y- given in English as J-; unit S08 (V.5)
formation: a cradle-name, its onset worn (y- < g-) and frozen

meanings: Wik (a cradle-name; names are names): Wick the runner, of the Tide of Remembering; the Book's English spells it Wick
derivation: *gwik-o-s > Hal wikos > wik (O4: gw > the new w; H2); a name: names are names (no sense given). Spelled with k after i at the end of a word (§2.4); unit S08 (V.5)

meanings: Enno (a cradle-name; names are names): Enno of the guild, the first post of Enrella
derivation: *ennoʔa > Hal ennoa > enno (O1: the catch between vowels lost; H2: the final short vowel lost), as Hale (*xaleʔa > hale) and Aske; a name: names are names (no sense given); unit S08 (V.5)

meanings: Della (a cradle-name; names are names): of Enrella, the second post
derivation: *dell-aʔ > Hal dellā > della (O1, H3: the final -ā kept as the feminine -a), as Denna (O0413) and Bena; a name: names are names (no sense given); unit S08 (V.5)

meanings: Enrella: the pair-name of Enno and Della, of the guild (sealed in high summer of the first year; both fell on the wall in the Joined Tide)
derivation: canon formation, the pair-name rule (orrowen_v2 §3.10): En- (the first syllable of his cradle-name, Enno) + softened Dell- (her cradle-name without its final vowel, d > r as the second element of a compound) + the lintel -a, as Idrenna (O1081: Id- + -renn- + -a); takes a dual verb; unit S08 (V.5)

meanings: a whistle; to whistle ('breath-song': a tune with no words in it); hossvellyl, whistling
derivation: hoss 'breath; breathe; live' (O1004, canon) + S vell 'a song; sing' (v unchanged; compound: the head softened, §3.10), the verb by zero derivation as vell itself is (lexicon §4.4); harmony from the head: slender (hossvellyl, hossvellent); unit S08 (V.5: Jory 'that whistled', Lanner 'whistled for the wind')
a phrase: garl 'a hand' + lo 'at' (+S) + S·garl (g > y before a vowel, §3.3), built as sest lo sest O3004 'side by side'; unit S08 (V.5: 'Enno and Della, Enrella, hand in hand')

orrowen: Tovv. Nath dunn et wadh tul.
meanings: 'Wait. The sea hath not finished.' (Corlen's saying before every holding: 'wait; the sea does not finish yet')
derivation: a phrase: Tovv wait-IMP + Nath NEG(+N) + dunn N·tunn 'whole; finish' (the verb by zero derivation, as re dhunn ullen O2984) + et the + wadh sea + tul yet (nath … tul 'not yet', orrowen_v2 §3.8); unit S08 (V.5; the same line stands in III.1 and the Epilogue)
